title: feat(console): UX polish across all console components
body:
Comprehensive UX audit of the console app — every component and page reviewed for enterprise-grade polish.

### Loading & Connection
- **LoadingScreen**: Multi-step progress indicator with animated check/spinner transitions instead of static spinner
- **ConnectionStatus**: Brief "Connected" flash (auto-dismiss 2s) on successful connection via `useEffect` timer

### Navigation
- **AppHeader**: Breadcrumb slugs humanized (`crm_dashboard` → `Crm Dashboard`), system admin routes added, record IDs shortened (`#abc123…`)

### Empty States
- All five "Not Found" views (Object, Dashboard, Page, Report, RecordDetail) now render contextual Lucide icons and actionable guidance text

### Error Recovery
- **ErrorBoundary**: Added "Go Home" alongside "Try Again"

### Shadcn Migration
- **ProfilePage**: Raw HTML `<input>`/`<button>`/`<label>` → Shadcn `Card`, `Input`, `Label`, `Alert`, `Avatar`, `Badge` with avatar section
- **System Admin Pages** (Users/Orgs/Roles/Audit): Raw HTML buttons → `Button`/`Card`/`Badge`, added page icons, centered empty states with contextual illustrations

### Roadmap
- Added §1.7 (Console UX Polish — completed) and §2.7 (Phase 2 — skeleton loading, toasts, keyboard shortcuts, onboarding, notification center)
